question: Does changing only relay ACP-0008 integration.decay_rate_z from 0.0125 to 0.00125 produce additional relay E2 discharges and canonical emissions with authenticated relay-to-destination enqueue and reception in the 75 retained DRIVE-LIMITED streams?

conditions.source: exact authenticated retained source-to-relay reception records
conditions.all_other_configuration: byte/value identical to the retained Luna-45 calibrated configuration

replication_boundary: Four separate fresh Python invocations; each stream has a fresh bounded E2 runtime and neurons. Initial and replay are deterministic retained replays, not independent samples.

runtime_boundary.source_to_relay_inputs: authenticated arrival records only; sorted by original queue_sequence and exact identity tie-break
runtime_boundary.downstream_boundary: process unchanged destination normally; do not route destination outputs
runtime_boundary.stream_reset: fresh runtime, relay, destination, queue, and sidecar state for every stream/condition/phase

execution_gate_order: verify starting-baseline ancestry, current E2 source blobs, exact retained Git objects, file hashes, internal artifact digests, and Luna-45 integrity catalog
authenticate both phase input captures and reconcile every retained source-to-relay enqueue/reception pair
execute initial and replay historical controls and require exact historical relay and destination compatibility
verify one-field relay-only intervention isolation before treatment
independently audit relay and destination recurrence, causal roots, enqueues/receptions, no-input isolation, bounds, and exact replay
write class summaries, manifests, and a contract-scoped verdict
primary_response: A treatment-minus-control increase in relay integration discharges that produce canonical relay emissions and are routed and received at destination with authenticated source-to-relay lineage.

decision_rule.SUPPORTED: At least one primary stream has a reproducible additional relay integration discharge and linked canonical emission successfully enqueued and received at the destination; every integrity, historical-control, one-field-isolation, no-input, boundedness, recurrence, routing, and replay gate passes.
decision_rule.NOT SUPPORTED: All required gates pass and no primary stream has an additional valid routed relay emission/reception.
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: All integrity/runtime gates pass but the observed primary difference cannot satisfy the full discharge/emission/reception causal endpoint.
decision_rule.BLOCKED: Any integrity, historical compatibility, config isolation, no-input, boundedness, recurrence, route reconciliation, or replay gate fails.

prohibited: no source simulation or generated/proxy input
no additional condition, parameter sweep, destination change, edge/topology change, training, structural plasticity, or task-efficacy run
no class label in runtime input or computation
no successor authorization, production recommendation, ACP/A01-A15 change, hardware-equivalence claim, or production promotion
